Fig. 3: Laplace uncertainty bounds on a novel test sequence. Top: Adaptation with 5 points (N = 10) yields a tight fit. Bottom: Adaptation with 1 point (N = 2) results in a poor pointwise fit, yet the ±3σ bounds correctly maintain the inherent sinusoidal structure learned from the prior.
Fig. 4: Deterministic and VAE reduced-order models: test FIT vs. training sequence length L.

(a) Benchmark test prediction displaying calibrated confidence intervals after MAP adaptation and Laplace uncertainty computation (L = 100). (b) Evaluation of empirical coverage against theoretical probability across different adaptation regimes.
Fig. 6: Evolution of model output uncertainty as a function of the adaptation sequence length.
